expected_outcomes: Account is created.

Unverified accounts are granted read-only access for 7 days upon login.

business_rules.description: Email must be verified via a confirmation link before the account is fully activated

business_rules.source_text: unverified accounts can still log in but are limited to read-only access for 7 days

preconditions: User has an active subscription plan
main_flow_steps: Initiate an upgrade to the Pro plan
Process payment with prorated charge based on days remaining in the current cycle
Grant access to advanced features immediately upon upgrading
Initiate a downgrade from Pro to Free or Team to Pro
Apply business rules regarding downgrade timing and member limits

inputs.constraints: Must be a valid plan type (Pro, Free, Team)

expected_outcomes: Upgrading mid-billing-cycle prorates the charge based on days remaining in the current cycle
Pro features are accessible immediately after upgrading
Downgrading from Pro to Free takes effect at the end of the current billing period
User retains Pro features until the end of the billing period when downgrading from Pro to Free
Downgrading from Team to Pro is blocked if team members exceed Pro allowances until members are removed

business_rules.description: Upgrading mid-billing-cycle must prorate the charge based on days remaining in the current cycle.
business_rules.source_text: Upgrading mid-billing-cycle should prorate the charge based on days remaining in the current cycle.

business_rules.description: Downgrading from Pro to Free must not be immediate and must take effect at the end of the current billing period.
business_rules.source_text: Downgrading from Pro to Free should NOT be immediate — it should take effect at the end of the current billing period, and the user keeps Pro features until then.

business_rules.description: Team-plan user downgrading to Pro with more team members than Pro allows must be blocked until members are removed.
business_rules.source_text: If a Team-plan user downgrades to Pro and currently has more team members than Pro allows, the downgrade should be blocked until they remove members, not silently truncate the team.

acceptance_criteria: An upgrade to the Pro plan grants immediate access to advanced features
An upgrade executed mid-billing-cycle calculates a prorated charge based on remaining days
A downgrade from Pro to Free does not apply immediately
A user downgrading from Pro to Free retains access to Pro features until the end of the current billing period
A downgrade from Team to Pro is blocked if the user exceeds the member limit of the Pro plan
A blocked downgrade prevents the plan change without silently truncating the team members

main_flow_steps: Initiate creation of a project or task
Submit the project or task creation request
expected_outcomes: Project or task is created if limits are not exceeded
Upgrade prompt is shown when attempting to create a project beyond the 3 active projects cap
HTTP 429 response with a retry-after header is returned when the API rate limit is exceeded

business_rules.description: Free tier is capped at 3 active projects
business_rules.source_text: The Free tier is capped at 3 active projects and 50 tasks per project.

business_rules.description: Free tier is capped at 50 tasks per project
business_rules.source_text: The Free tier is capped at 3 active projects and 50 tasks per project.

business_rules.description: API requests are rate-limited to 60 requests/minute for Free tier and 600/minute for Pro/Team
business_rules.source_text: API requests are rate-limited to 60 requests/minute for Free tier and 600/minute for Pro/Team

acceptance_criteria: Free-tier user can create up to 3 active projects successfully
Free-tier user can create up to 50 tasks per project successfully
Attempting to create a project beyond the 3 project cap displays an upgrade prompt instead of a generic error
API requests exceeding 60 requests/minute for Free tier return a 429 status code with a retry-after header

structured_requirement.feature_name: Team Member Invitation and Role Management
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
The target user holds exactly one role per team
main_flow_steps: Invite a teammate to the team
Assign a role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) to the invited teammate

inputs.constraints: must be Admin, Editor, or Viewer

expected_outcomes: Teammate receives an invitation
Teammate is assigned the specified role upon joining

business_rules.description: A user holds exactly one role per team.
business_rules.source_text: A user holds exactly one role per team.

business_rules.description: Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another Admin.
business_rules.source_text: Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another Admin

business_rules.description: Admins cannot remove the owner.
business_rules.source_text: Admins cannot remove the owner.

business_rules.description: If the owner's account is deleted, ownership automatically transfers to the longest-tenured Admin.
business_rules.source_text: If the owner's account is deleted, ownership should automatically transfer to the longest-tenured Admin rather than leaving the team ownerless.

acceptance_criteria: Account owner can successfully invite a teammate and assign an Admin, Editor, or Viewer role
A user is restricted to holding exactly one role per team
Only the account owner is able to transfer ownership to another Admin
Admins are prevented from removing the account owner
Deletion of the owner's account automatically transfers ownership to the longest-tenured Admin

preconditions: User is eligible for a trial (one-time per account based on verified email)
main_flow_steps: User starts the 14-day Pro trial
System grants full Pro features during the trial
User optionally adds a payment method during the trial
System checks for payment method addition and processes account status on day 14
expected_outcomes: User receives full Pro features during the trial period
Account automatically downgrades to Free on day 14 if no payment method is added
First charge for an added payment method occurs on day 15 rather than immediately upon adding the card
Re-signing up with the same verified email does not grant a second trial

business_rules.description: If no payment method is added by day 14, the account automatically downgrades to Free rather than continuing Pro access unpaid.
business_rules.source_text: If no payment method is added by day 14, the account should automatically downgrade to Free rather than continuing Pro access unpaid.

business_rules.description: If a payment method is added during the trial, the first charge occurs on day 15, not immediately on adding the card.
business_rules.source_text: If a payment method IS added during the trial, the first charge should not occur until day 15, not immediately on adding the card.

business_rules.description: Trial eligibility is one-time per account and re-signing up with the same verified email does not grant a second trial.
business_rules.source_text: Trial eligibility is one-time per account — re-signing up with the same verified email should not grant a second trial

acceptance_criteria: User gets full Pro features during the 14-day trial
Account downgrades to Free on day 14 if no payment method is provided
Adding a payment method during the trial does not result in an immediate charge
First charge for the added payment method occurs on day 15
Re-signing up with the same verified email does not grant a second trial

main_flow_steps: Export all data before deleting the account
Request account deletion
Enter a 24-hour grace period
Permanently purge data after the 24-hour grace period if not canceled
expected_outcomes: Data is exported in a machine-readable format
Account deletion request initiates a 24-hour grace period
Account deletion can be canceled during the grace period
Data is permanently purged after the grace period expires

business_rules.description: Account deletion is a two-step process consisting of a request followed by a 24-hour grace period.
business_rules.source_text: Account deletion is a two-step process: request deletion, then a 24-hour grace period during which the user can cancel it, after which data is permanently purged.

business_rules.description: A team-plan export triggered by a non-owner member must only include that member's own tasks and exclude the rest of the team's data.
business_rules.source_text: a team-plan export triggered by a non-owner member should only include that member's own tasks, not the whole team's data.

acceptance_criteria: User can export all data in a machine-readable format prior to account deletion.
User can request account deletion, initiating a 24-hour grace period.
User can cancel the account deletion during the 24-hour grace period.
Data is permanently purged automatically after the 24-hour grace period expires without cancellation.
A team-plan export triggered by a non-owner member includes only that specific member's tasks.
